headline: DPA must balance local open-weights trials and European-hosted model assessments with rigorous supply-chain security and strict dependency lockdowns.

calls.title: Trial Inkling 2 Mini for local tasks
calls.text: Test the 26.4B-parameter Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model locally for developer assistance and lightweight document extraction tasks, leveraging its small ~20GB footprint and strong coding performance to streamline local development for financial-services data pipelines.

calls.title: Assess Mistral models for financial reporting
calls.text: Evaluate Mistral's new models and European-hosted enterprise offerings for processing confidential financial documents and structuring investor reports, ensuring robust data compliance and multimodal accuracy for asset management clients.

calls.title: Caution required with dependencies and wrappers
calls.text: Immediately audit and lock down all dependency repositories and avoid unverified third-party wrappers to prevent credential theft and data leaks when handling confidential client documents and building agentic financial workflows.
